title: security-rbac-v2-kms-region-residency-audit-hardening
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: customers in regulated industries require stronger enforcement and observability for KMS-backed data residency controls. This PR hardens RBAC v2 policy validation and audit logging so that KMS region pinning is enforced at request admission, logged with region-level metadata, and surfaced in the Console. Motivation: close gaps observed during recent SOC review and an internal incident where cross-region KMS keys were used inadvertently. Scope: - Enforce KMS region residency when a policy requires region pinning (fail-fast at admission). - Emit structured audit events with kms_region, key_id, requester_role, and policy_id. - Add RBAC v2 policy validators to ensure residency assertions are consistent with org-level constraints. - Console UX: surface residency policy violations and a remediation link. Checklist: - [x] Add admission enforcement in services/kms - [x] Emit structured audit logs with region metadata - [x] Add unit/integration tests for policy validation and audit entries - [x] Update Console to show policy violations and remediation path - [x] Add docs and migration notes (docs/security/kms-region-residency.md) Related: ENG-1998 (policy hardening), SEC-402 (audit logging baseline). Important notes: Migration path includes a staged rollout (audit-only -> enforce) controlled by feature flag feature.kms_residency.enforce. Default rollout is audit-only for 2 weeks in canary, then full enforcement subject to metrics (no violations > 0.1% of requests). Rollback plan: disable enforcement flag; fallback to region-agnostic key selection. Backwards compatibility: this PR is non-breaking for customers that do not enable region residency flags. Testing: unit tests added for validator logic, and integration tests added that spin up a local KMS stub and assert admission rejection for mismatched region. Observability: new metrics rbac.kms_residency.rejections and audit.kms_region.events emitted to the internal metrics pipeline. Docs: added migration/ops guidance and sample policies. Implementation details and rationale are in the commits summary.
commits_summary: 6 commits: add kms residency enforcement handler; structured audit events; rbav v2 validator updates; console UI to display residency violations; tests and fixtures; docs and helm values for rollout flags.
